title: Bosch 60cm Series 6 Built Under Dishwasher Stainless Steel (SMU6HAS01A) $1095 Delivered @ Appliances Online
body:
Deal: Bosch 60cm Series 6 Built Under Dishwasher Stainless Steel (SMU6HAS01A) $1095 Delivered @ Appliances Online

[Mortin] Only 2 year warranty
AEG is giving 10 year warranty on fully integrated models
[Mortin] https://www.binglee.com.au/products/bosch-14pl-semi-integrat…
[Acejos] Doesnt have the front panel. If you have the carpentry panel then yes this model is for you. Anyone else who have just a hole in the kitchen then you need the model i posted.
[Jayblesz] This is series 4. OP is series 6.
This is the equivalent semi-integrated https://www.binglee.com.au/products/bosch-smi6hcs01a-60cm-se…
[saltysalt] 2 year warranty is fine because manufacturers warranties are pretty meaningless tbh. Australian consumer law will cover you for a 'reasonable amount of time', which is probably around 8 years on a dishwasher. You might just have a bit of a fight on your hands with Appliances Online depending on the issue.
https://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-10-26/how-long-should-a-fri…
[Navgsc] For $104 more, I would pick this Asko any day. Five year warranty, built like a tank, more like industrial dishwashers and inside is fully stainless still including the two blades.
[Makaveli99] Yup better. Also less microplastics exposure, but this some plastic components
[Navgsc] Yes. I’ve checked almost all the dishwashers on the market, including Miele, and Asko has the fewest plastic components.
[Acejos] I bought this bosch to replace the old Asko machine currently now. From the 4 years I have nothing but trouble with Asko. After the first 2 years and a bit- the control board died need replacement. Then after half year later with the F12 inlet error- and either pointing to the bottom circuit board or the water inlet flow meter sensor.
My 20 years old Asus notebook motherboard last longer than this crapo dishwasher. I paid $1600 about 5 years ago on promo- for the next model up DBI565IK- It is so crap that they build the buttons and control on top of the door- Water would run from your finger (if you have wet hand) to the controller board and kill it - that my guess on how it died.
[Damonator84] Have this with extended warranty, solid deal
[saltysalt] See the link in my above comment, extended warranties are generally a scam as you are generally covered by consumer rights.
[paddywide] Good deal, I am using series 6.Good quality and abosolutely worth it.
